Every action in the [terminal GUI](/gui/) is also a command, for scripts, CI and IDE tools. The examples use the short `ml10n` name; inside a project you can always write `dart run modular_l10n_generator` instead.

When a required value is missing and you are in a terminal, the command asks for it. In scripts and CI it stops with exit code `64` instead, so nothing ever waits for input.

## Options every command takes

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--root=<dir>` | Project directory. Defaults to the nearest folder with a `pubspec.yaml`, starting from the current one. |
| `-v, --verbose` | Show progress detail. |
| `-q, --quiet` | Only show errors. |
| `--[no-]generate` | Commands that change ARB files regenerate the Dart code afterwards. `--no-generate` skips that. |
| `--force` | Generate even when the settings collide with Flutter Intl. |
| `-h, --help` | Print the command's usage. |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | Success. |
| `1` | The command failed: generation errors, problems found by `check`, unsorted files under `sort --check`, or warnings under `--fatal-warnings`. |
| `64` | Usage error: unknown option, invalid value, or a missing value when not in a terminal. |

## Project

### `generate`

Generate the localization code once.

```sh
ml10n generate [arguments]
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--class-name=<value>` | Name of the generated entry-point class. |
| `--output-dir=<value>` | Output directory, relative to the project root. |
| `--default-locale=<value>` | Template locale (for example en). |
| `--arb-pattern=<value>` | Glob for ARB files, relative to the project root. |
| `--module-access=<value>` | part: modules are reachable only through the entry point. library: each module file can be imported directly. One of `part`, `library`. |
| `--[no-]combined-arb` | Write one merged ARB file per locale. |
| `--[no-]deferred-loading` | Load locale tables lazily. |
| `--log-level=<value>` | One of `silent`, `error`, `warning`, `verbose`. |
| `--fatal-warnings` | Exit with code 1 when there are warnings (for CI). |

```sh
# Generate once (also what plain `modular_l10n_generator` does)
ml10n generate

# Fail CI on warnings
ml10n generate --fatal-warnings

# Try a different class name without editing pubspec.yaml
ml10n generate --class-name L10n
```

### `watch`

Generate, then regenerate whenever an ARB file or pubspec.yaml changes.

```sh
ml10n watch [arguments]
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--class-name=<value>` | Name of the generated entry-point class. |
| `--output-dir=<value>` | Output directory, relative to the project root. |
| `--default-locale=<value>` | Template locale (for example en). |
| `--arb-pattern=<value>` | Glob for ARB files, relative to the project root. |
| `--module-access=<value>` | part: modules are reachable only through the entry point. library: each module file can be imported directly. One of `part`, `library`. |
| `--[no-]combined-arb` | Write one merged ARB file per locale. |
| `--[no-]deferred-loading` | Load locale tables lazily. |
| `--log-level=<value>` | One of `silent`, `error`, `warning`, `verbose`. |
| `--fatal-warnings` | Exit with code 1 when there are warnings (for CI). |

```sh
# Regenerate on every ARB save
ml10n watch
```

### `gui`

Open the interactive terminal app: every action in one place, with folder browsing and guided steps.

Alias: `ui`.

```sh
ml10n gui [arguments]
```

```sh
# Open the terminal app
ml10n gui
```

### `init`

Set up Modular L10n: add the modular_l10n section to pubspec.yaml and create the first module.

```sh
ml10n init [arguments]
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--default-locale=<en>` | Template locale. |
| `--module=<value>` | Name of the first module (snake_case). |
| `--dir=<value>` | Folder for the first module, relative to the current directory. Its ARB files go in <dir>/l10n/. |
| `--class-name=<ML>` | Generated class name. |
| `-y, --yes` | Re-initialize without asking when already configured. |

```sh
# Ask for each value
ml10n init

# No questions (scripts)
ml10n init --default-locale en --module app --dir lib/app --class-name ML
```

### `doctor`

Check the project setup: configuration, modules, dependencies and conflicts with Flutter Intl.

```sh
ml10n doctor [arguments]
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--fix` | Apply the fixes that only need a pubspec.yaml change. |

```sh
# Report
ml10n doctor

# Apply the pubspec.yaml fixes
ml10n doctor --fix
```

## Modules and keys

### `create-module`

Create a module: an l10n/ folder with one ARB file per locale. Also adds missing locale files to an existing module folder.

Alias: `module`.

```sh
ml10n create-module [arguments]
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dir=<value>` | Feature folder, relative to the current directory. The ARB files go in <dir>/l10n/. |
| `--name=<value>` | Module name (snake_case). Defaults to the folder name. |
| `--locales=<value>` | Comma-separated locales. Defaults to the project's locales. |
| `--empty` | Do not add the <module>Title starter key. |
| `--overwrite` | Replace ARB files that already exist. |

```sh
# Module named after the folder
ml10n create-module --dir lib/features/auth

# Pick the name and locales
ml10n create-module --dir lib/features/auth --name auth --locales en,ar,fr
```

### `add-key`

Add a translation key to a module, in every locale.

```sh
ml10n add-key [arguments]
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-m, --module=<value>` | Module to add the key to. |
| `-k, --key=<value>` | Key name (camelCase). |
| `--value=<en=Hello>` | A translation, as locale=text. Repeat per locale. Repeatable. |
| `--description=<value>` | Description for translators. |
| `--placeholder=<count:int>` | A placeholder, as name or name:type. Repeatable. Repeatable. |

```sh
# Plain text
ml10n add-key -m auth -k emailLabel --value en=Email --value fr=E-mail

# With a placeholder and a description
ml10n add-key -m home -k cartItems --value 'en={count, plural, =0{Empty} one{1 item} other{{count} items}}' --placeholder count:int --description 'Cart badge'
```

### `rename-key`

Rename a key in every locale file and update its uses in lib/.

```sh
ml10n rename-key [arguments]
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-m, --module=<value>` | Module of the key. |
| `--from=<value>` | Current key name. |
| `--to=<value>` | New key name. |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would change without changing it. |

```sh
# Preview
ml10n rename-key -m auth --from emailLabel --to email --dry-run

# Rename in ARB files and Dart code
ml10n rename-key -m auth --from emailLabel --to email
```

## Locales

### `add-locale`

Add a locale to every module (copies the default locale's keys with empty values).

```sh
ml10n add-locale <locale>
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-l, --locale=<value>` | Locale to add. |

```sh
# Add French to every module
ml10n add-locale fr

# With a region
ml10n add-locale pt_BR
```

### `remove-locale`

Delete a locale's ARB file from every module.

```sh
ml10n remove-locale <locale>
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-l, --locale=<value>` | Locale to remove. |
| `-y, --yes` | Do not ask. |

```sh
# Remove without asking (scripts)
ml10n remove-locale fr --yes
```

### `pseudo-locale`

Generate an accented, lengthened copy of the default locale to test layouts and spot hardcoded text.

```sh
ml10n pseudo-locale [arguments]
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-l, --locale=<value>` | Pseudo-locale code. Default: `en_XA`. |
| `--expansion=<value>` | Extra length as a fraction (0.3 = 30% longer, like German). Default: `0.3`. |

```sh
# Default: en_XA, 30% longer
ml10n pseudo-locale

# Longer text
ml10n pseudo-locale --locale en_XB --expansion 0.5
```

## Quality

### `check`

Find missing and empty translations, ICU mistakes and direct module imports. Exits 1 on errors (for CI).

```sh
ml10n check [arguments]
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--hints` | Also show ICU hints. |
| `--unused` | Also list unused keys. |
| `--hardcoded` | Also list hardcoded UI strings in Dart code. |
| `--fatal-warnings` | Exit 1 on warnings too, not only errors. |

```sh
# Errors only fail the run
ml10n check

# Everything, and fail on warnings too
ml10n check --unused --hardcoded --hints --fatal-warnings
```

### `sort`

Sort ARB keys alphabetically (@@ attributes first, each @key after its key).

```sh
ml10n sort [arguments]
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-m, --module=<value>` | Only this module. |
| `--check` | Change nothing; exit 1 when a file is not sorted (for CI). |

```sh
# Sort every ARB file
ml10n sort

# CI: fail when unsorted
ml10n sort --check
```

### `unused`

List keys no Dart file under lib/ references; --remove deletes them.

```sh
ml10n unused [arguments]
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--remove` | Delete the unused keys from every locale file. |
| `-y, --yes` | Do not ask. |

```sh
# List
ml10n unused

# Delete them from every locale
ml10n unused --remove --yes
```

### `hardcoded`

List string literals in lib/ that look like UI text.

```sh
ml10n hardcoded [arguments]
```

```sh
# List UI strings in lib/
ml10n hardcoded
```

### `extract`

Move a string literal into an ARB file and replace it with the generated lookup.

```sh
ml10n extract [arguments]
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--file=<value>` | Dart file. |
| `--line=<value>` | Line of the string (1-based). |
| `--column=<value>` | Column inside the string (1-based). |
| `-m, --module=<value>` | Module to add the key to. |
| `-k, --key=<value>` | Key name. Suggested from the text when omitted. |

```sh
# Move the string at line 12, column 15 into the profile module
ml10n extract --file lib/features/profile/profile_screen.dart --line 12 --column 15 -m profile
```

## Exchange

### `export`

Export translations to CSV (for spreadsheets) or XLIFF 1.2 (for translation tools).

```sh
ml10n export [arguments]
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-o, --output=<value>` | File to write; .csv or .xlf/.xliff decides the format. Default: `translations.csv`. |
| `--format=<value>` | Override the format. One of `csv`, `xliff`. |
| `-m, --module=<value>` | Only this module. |

```sh
# Spreadsheet
ml10n export -o translations.csv

# One module, for a translation tool
ml10n export -m auth -o auth.xlf
```

### `import`

Import translations from a CSV or XLIFF file made by "export". Only existing keys are filled; empty cells are ignored.

```sh
ml10n import <file>
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | Show the changes without writing them. |

```sh
# Preview
ml10n import translations.csv --dry-run

# Apply
ml10n import translations.csv
```

### `migrate`

Move Flutter Intl intl_*.arb files into modules.

```sh
ml10n migrate [arguments]
```

Regenerates the Dart code afterwards (`--no-generate` to skip).

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--mode=<value>` | `single`: Every key into one module.; `prefix`: Split keys by camelCase prefix (authLogin → auth). |
| `--from=<value>` | Folder with the intl_*.arb files. Default: `lib/l10n`. |
| `--module=<value>` | Module name (single mode). |
| `--dir=<value>` | Module folder (single mode). |
| `--base-dir=<value>` | Folder that receives one sub-folder per prefix (prefix mode). Default: `lib/features`. |
| `--overwrite` | Replace existing module files. |
| `-y, --yes` | Do not ask. |

```sh
# Everything into one module
ml10n migrate --mode single --module app --dir lib/app

# One module per key prefix
ml10n migrate --mode prefix --base-dir lib/features
```
